_doc: Public example file for vehicle matcher schema. This file documents the format expected by vehicle_matcher/match.py. Each entry is a known vehicle profile that the matcher scores against incoming alert signatures. The real deployment replaces this with data/vehicles/known_vehicles.json (gitignored) containing operator-specific profiles.
_see_also: docs/PRIVACY.md for why the real data file is not committed.
